hooks.command: sql=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.sql // empty' 2>/dev/null) && [ -z "$sql" ] && exit 0; normalized=$(printf '%s' "$sql" | sed "s|/\*[^*]*\*/||g; s|--[^\n]*||g" | tr '\n\t' '  ' | tr -s ' ' | tr '[:lower:]' '[:upper:]') && printf '%s' "$normalized" | grep -qE '\b(DROP|DELETE|TRUNCATE|INSERT|UPDATE|MERGE)\b|\bCREATE[[:space:]]+OR[[:space:]]+REPLACE\b' && echo 'Impact Radar is read-only. It only uses GET_LINEAGE and git diff.' && exit 2 || true

fp=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null) && [ -z "$fp" ] && exit 0; printf '%s' "$fp" | grep -qE '(\.env$|connections\.toml$|\.pem$|credentials)' && echo 'Reading credential files is not allowed.' && exit 2 || true
